description: A list of actions or options that opens from a button, such as an account menu or a "⋯" button on a table row.
anatomy: Context Menu and Menubar use the same parts.

checkboxes.title: Checkbox Items
checkboxes.description: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem for on/off options, such as which table columns to show.

radio.title: Radio Items
radio.description: DropdownMenuRadioGroup to pick one of several options, such as the sort order.

rowActions.title: Table Row Actions
rowActions.description: A "⋯" button with a red dangerous action (variant="destructive").

parts.trigger: The button that opens the menu.
parts.checkbox: An option that can be checked.
parts.radio: A single choice within a group.
parts.label: Small title above a group.
parts.shortcut: Keyboard shortcut on the right of an item.
parts.sub: A sub-menu that opens to the side.

props.inset: Indent the text to line up with items that have a check mark.
props.align: Menu alignment relative to the button.
